experiment: Vocabulary size versus stability and efficiency
feature_extractor: Frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 global CLS features

classifier_settings.selection: Fixed C values from the Experiment 3 validation selections; no hyperparameter search in this experiment.

measurements: validation accuracy and F1 across seeds
pairwise ARI and NMI of training assignments
representation payload and amortized shared model storage
median CPU encoding plus classifier prediction time
storage_note: Per-image feature payload is estimated from the stored representation dtype. Shared codebook, scaler and classifier array parameters are amortized over 50,000 images. DINOv2 backbone storage and Python/joblib serialization overhead are excluded.
timing_note: Inference time is the median of three CPU measurements on the validation features. DINOv2 feature extraction and model training are excluded.
